description: This file defines a React functional component 'CacheFieldRenderer' that renders various input fields based on provided field metadata, including fetching available models from an external API and rendering different input types such as checkboxes, text inputs, number inputs, textareas, and select dropdowns.

methods.name: CacheFieldRenderer
methods.description: React functional component rendering form fields based on 'field' type and 'currentValue'. It fetches model info asynchronously and displays appropriate input components.
